text:
maya: Heads-up — eu-southeast dedicated pool eu-se-3 is queuing hard, tail latency climbing ~3x. Paging infra.
ops-bot: ALERT: pool eu-se-3 gpu_util=98% for 6m, queue_depth=420, reclaim_attempts=12

sherwin: Looking now. Any autoscaler activity?

maya: Autoscaler tried but failing with quota errors. Extract from node-controller logs: `AutoscalerError: quotaExceeded CPU_PER_PROJECT` and `failed to create instance: quota exceeded`

eli: If autoscaler won't add nodes quickly we should shift low-priority traffic to hosted. Keep gold/tiered pinned to dedicated.

maya: Agreed. Proposal: immediate weight adjustments — hosted weight +0.35 for bronze, +0.15 for silver. Keep gold pinned to dedicated. Also evict non-critical preemptible test workloads. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/infra/eu-capacity-handoff

sofia: Quick cost FYI — rough calc at current QPS: moving bronze -> hosted for 6h ~ +$2.8k. We can absorb for incident window but need to track. :money_with_wings:

katie: Approve emergency shift. Prioritize user-visible SLAs.

sherwin: Executing weight shift now: `redwoodctl route adjust --region eu-southeast --class bronze --hosted-weight 0.35 --class silver --hosted-weight 0.15`

ops-bot: ACTION: route-adjust job started (job_id=ra-8921)

sherwin: route-adjust job completed — bronze -> hosted applied. Evicting preemptible runbooks and draining two low-priority pools.

ops-bot: METRICS SNAPSHOT: p99_latency (eu-se-3) 2.8s -> 0.9s, queue_depth 420 -> 78, in-flight requests shifted=318

eli: Can we pre-warm small model variants on hosted to avoid cold starts for bronze? Recommend `model-prewarm --region eu-southeast --model rdm-m-small --replicas 4`

maya: Prewarm kicked for rdm-m-small (task id=prewarm-552). Also opened cloud quota ticket (INC-1245) to request CPU/GPU quota bump for project in eu-southeast. If quota comes back and autoscaler recovers, we'll reverse weights.

sofia: Noted. I'll run a short cost/runbook postmortem after incident — cc @finance.

katie: Thanks — good call. Keep communication to on-call channel for status updates.

maya: Monitoring. Queue depth trending down, dedicated pool still high but stabilizing. Will update in 30m. :thumbsup:
